plan.reason: Previous ordinary polynomial controls show OOD residual; test a stronger existing nonlinear predictor before attributing it to a world-model research gap.
plan.scope: New controlled real-data baseline, not native-paper reproduction or proposed new architecture.
plan.OOD: Same wave/regime recordings, no test/OOD hyperparameter selection
plan.model: Two separate HGB direct-next-RPM regressors per information arm, max_iter200,lr.05,max_leaf_nodes31,l2=1,random_state1802,internal10%training validation earlystop.
plan.capacity_control: More flexible than ridge; not parameter/compute matched, intentionally an existing strong stop baseline.
plan.clock: Reuse frozen clock predictor from prior control fit; no extra sensor outcome inputs
plan.horizon: Same16step autoregressive roots every64 rows. Group diagnostics exclude roots crossing a regime boundary.
plan.acceptance: If ordinary nonlinear prediction explains prior failure, reject a new-method claim. Unknown measurement transformation/target support remains a competing explanation even if this baseline fails.
